description: Credential scatter cleanup: one leaked API key (ACCT-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) is spread across five spots in a captured developer home, including inside a tar archive; redact every occurrence with REDACTED (repacking the tar) and inventory each location with its occurrence count plus the 8-char key prefix.

criteria: The agent replaced every occurrence of the leaked key with REDACTED in all five locations (extracting and repacking the tar), left no copy of the original value anywhere in the tree, and wrote the per-location occurrence counts plus the 8-char key_id prefix to report/creds.txt without leaking the full key.
